svg.title: Millrace Station, painted
svg.desc: Millrace Station seen from the sea: a stacked, rusting arcology on the drowned shelf under grey-green water, its window rows sodium yellow, floodlight cones in the murk, rotor frames on the seabed below, and in the distance the tops of drowned city towers breaking the surface in the rain.

text.textPath: TIDAL DIRECTORATE · SEALED AND COUNTED · TIDAL DIRECTORATE ·
